name: @agenticprimitives-demo/discovery
description: Discovery reference UI (demo-discovery): a fixture-driven explorer for the AP-native registry kit (spec 279). Public agent search + per-agent EVIDENCE PATH (signed-card binding, registry entry, claims, SHACL status, cited public facts) verified live in the browser with @agenticprimitives/registry-kit + agent-profile, plus an admin-only ap:abox:pentest exposure-findings view. Demo only — fixture A-box; the production explorer + GraphDB indexer live in external repos (ADR-0037).
